correctness.rationale: Direct composition yields d=2^m. Fixed points solve p=R_q(x)=x/[1−q(1−x)²]^d. Sign R_q′=sign(1−q(1−x)[1+(2d−1)x]), with a unique quadratic maximum d²/(2d−1) yielding q_d, the two fold roots and global at-most-three census. Strictly increasing return gives monotone convergence and excludes other periodic orbits. SymPy independently verified cusp fixed-point identities and G′=1, G″=0, G‴=−(2d−1)^3/[d²(d−1)] at d=4,8,32. Cubic coefficient implies n^{-1/2} constant; d log(1−c(1−x)²/d) gives Gaussian limit. Finite calculations corroborate, not prove all m.
